bin_direction: Bin0 hottest / most protected; Bin7 coldest / first reclaim
coldness: trapezoidal restricted mean survival time over [0,180] / 180

gate.dvr: point delta <= 0 and upper95 <= 0 for both horizons, zero noninferiority margin
gate.other: CP1, CP3 or conditional observed victim median lower95 > 0
gate.sampling_robustness: same mapper must pass all conditions for both training samplers on episode metrics
gate.support: all paired gate comparisons use identical known outcomes; repeated old test is development, not untouched holdout

stop_after: Gate-2 regardless of result; no runtime/kernel changes
training_budget_note: One-query cap/patience increased before any test evaluation after validation showed slower convergence and ~14x fewer optimizer steps per epoch; same seed, optimizer, labels and Gate criteria.
